title: Categorizer follow-ups after budget-fvtx: reasoning-effort gating per OpenAI model, attempt counter rules, masking gaps, >200 categories, run-level token cap, live provider check
description: From review-fvtx-3.md (no blockers). 1) request-shape 400s count toward the 3-attempt cap and capped rows only return through force, which nothing calls. 2) attempt counter rises on every outcome; a stale-heartbeat retry can count twice. 3) list limit 200 also limits allowed category ids. 4) reasoning effort is sent to gpt-5*-chat-latest and o1-mini/o1-preview, which may reject it (a 400 on every call stops a run after 3); DeepSeek gets it for every model; 'low' turns reasoning on for models whose default is none. Needs one live call per adapter with real keys. 5) maskFreeText misses spaced CPFs, account 56789-0, (11) 98765-4321, e-mail PIX keys; over-masks DT 20261124, LOJA 0001234, NF numbers; payee and import payee names reach the prompt unmasked. 6) the 3-in-a-row stop is per chunk. 7) 81-minute chunk deadline vs one 429 wait per transaction; no run-level token cap (worst case 8M tokens). 8) comments name a test file that does not exist. 9) equivalence test lacks a credit-card-payment fixture. Also deferred from review 2: heartbeat-resume lag, continue-as-new.
notes: Mostly obsolete: the old agent, reasoning-effort and masking code were deleted 2026-11-26. Re-check only the >200 categories item (Jev limit is 255 options incl. accounts; run stops with categorize_too_many_categories).
